newsitem.title: FRANCE: LVMH H1 SALES 21.59 BLN FFR.
newsitem.headline: LVMH H1 SALES 21.59 BLN FFR.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)
NOTE - LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton gave its sales in a statement.
It said they were up 62 percent, reflecting the acquisition this year of control of U.S.-based Duty Free Shoppers which contributed 6,927 million francs to selective luxury goods retailing.
On a like for like basis, LVMH's first-half sales rose 9.4 percent.
Sales of perfumes and beauty products rose six percent, it said.
Volume sales of champagne rose three percent, bolstered by exports to the United States, Japan and other European countries.
A 10 percent rise in cognac volumes sold in the United States offset part of the impact of a planned reduction of inventories in Japan, LVMH said.
It said the rise in leather goods revenue was due mainly to a 22 percent increase in Louis Vuitton luggage sales.
